item.description:
STORY | Delhi's AQI slips to ‘very poor’ as thick smog engulfs city; Jahangirpuri worst at 452

Delhi’s air quality slipped into the ‘very poor’ category at 332 as a thick layer of smog engulfed the national capital on Tuesday morning, with Jahangirpuri recording the highest reading at 452 in the ‘severe category’, according to the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).

The development comes a day after the city recorded its first ‘very poor’ air quality day of the season, with the AQI settling at 324 on Monday.

According to the CPCB data, eight of the 57 monitoring stations in Delhi recorded severe air quality at 9 am, while 32 stations were in the very poor category.

Two stations recorded moderate air quality, while the remaining 15 were in the poor category.

Jahangirpuri recorded the worst air quality, with the AQI crossing 452, placing it in the severe category.

According to the CPCB, an AQI between zero and 50 is classified as good, 51 and 100 as satisfactory, 101 and 200 as moderate, 201 and 300 as poor, 301 and 400 as very poor, and 401 and 500 as severe.

Amid the plummeting air quality, the minimum temperature at Safdarjung, Delhi's primary weather station, settled at 16.4 degrees Celsius, 1.1 degrees above the season's average.

Among the other weather stations, Palam recorded a minimum temperature of 16.2 degrees Celsius, with no departure from the seasonal average. Lodhi Road settled at 16.2 degrees Celsius, 3.2 degrees above normal, while the Ridge station recorded 17.7 degrees Celsius, 0.6 degrees above normal.

Ayanagar recorded a minimum temperature of 17.2 degrees Celsius, one degree above the seasonal average.

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast a mainly clear sky for Tuesday, with the maximum temperature expected to settle around 29 degrees Celsius.

item.description:
A press release issued by Ministry of External Affairs says, "National Security Adviser Mr. Ajit Doval undertook an official visit to Ha Noi, Viet Nam on 1-2 November 2026.

2. During the visit, NSA met General Luong Tam Quang, Politburo Member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Viet Nam (CPV) and Minister of Public Security of Viet Nam. Both sides discussed ongoing security and intelligence cooperation, including law enforcement, cyber, maritime, and economic security. They agreed to strengthen capacity building in these fields.

3. NSA called on H. E. Mr. To Lam, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the CPV and State President and conveyed the warm greetings of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi to the General Secretary.

4. NSA also met General Phan Van Giang, Politburo Member of the Central Committee of the CPV, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence, and Mr. Le Hoai Trung, Politburo Member of the Central Committee of the CPV and Minister of Foreign Affairs.

5. NSA visited the historic Quan Su Pagoda, in Ha Noi, which is the headquarters of the National Viet Nam Buddhist Sangha (VBS).

6. India and Viet Nam will be celebrating the 55th anniversary of the establishment of bilateral diplomatic relations in 2027. The visit provided an opportunity to review the progress in bilateral cooperation under the India-Vietnam Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership."

item.description:
STORY | Need to make judicial system more accessible, efficient through modern tech: CJI Surya Kant

Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said the judicial system must be made more accessible, efficient and responsive through modern technology, stressing that digital innovation must complement, not replace, judicial wisdom and human judgment.

Addressing a gathering at the inauguration of the Jharkhand High Court data centre here on Monday, he said the success of technological initiatives in the judiciary should not be measured by the sophistication of the systems installed but by the tangible difference they make to litigants, advocates, judges and citizens.

The inauguration was accompanied by the launch of the high court's revamped website, an online certified copy application for the civil courts of Jharkhand, a personalised cause list and speech-to-text software.

Describing the initiatives as important steps towards strengthening judicial administration, Justice Kant said modern courts increasingly depend on digital records, electronic communication and timely access to information.

"Judicial infrastructure, therefore, must evolve to meet these requirements and ensure greater reliability and efficiency in the delivery of justice," he said.

item.description:
STORY | Cyclonic storm Murasu wreaks havoc in coastal Andhra Pradesh

The severe cyclonic storm Murasu has left a trail of destruction in coastal Andhra Pradesh, uprooting thousands of trees, damaging hundreds of electric poles, and wrecking fishing boats, with people recounting their ordeal as the cyclone crossed the coast early on Tuesday.

Districts including Bapatla and Prakasam witnessed heavy rainfall and gusty winds, causing extensive damage to standing crops, and many places came under sheets of water.

"This is the most dangerous cyclone we have witnessed in the last 14 years. The government has been very helpful and evacuated around 400 families from our village. NDRF teams also helped us shift to safer places," Krishnamma, a fisherman from Kothapatnam in Prakasam district, told PTI, adding, now he has to find out the condition of his boats.

Another local resident, Mangamma, said she had lost her house during an earlier cyclone, but this time the government evacuated them before the landfall.

"I had lost my house in an earlier cyclone, and my family was also shattered. This time, the government evacuated us before the cyclone made the landfall. However, one of my three boats has been completely destroyed. Fishing is our livelihood," she said.

READ: https://www.ptinews.com/story/national/cyclonic-storm-murasu-wreaks-havoc-in-coastal-andhra-pradesh/4225997

The ministry says a cyberattack enabled bogus messages and that remediation work was underway. Local outlet http://59.RU independently reports recipients in Perm and shows the false alert.

STORY | US votes for mid-term elections, seen as referendum on Trump

Americans will vote on Tuesday in one of the most consequential elections in recent times, widely seen as a referendum on Donald Trump’s presidency that has been marked by a prolonged war in Iran, rising inflation, trade wars and deep divisions in society.

The polling will decide whether President Trump’s Republican Party retains control of the House of Representatives and the Senate, the two chambers of the US Congress, or, as opinion polls are predicting, the Democratic Party wrests control of at least the House if not the Senate, also in the final two years of Trump’s second term in office.

At stake in the elections are all 435 seats of the House and 37 seats in the 100-member Senate.

Elections are also being held for the post of Governor in 36 states, including in Ohio, where Indian American Vivek Ramaswamy is locked in a keen contest with his rival and Democratic nominee Amy Acton.

A number of Indian American candidates are in the electoral fray for posts ranging from Governor to city council members. Democrat Nithya Raman, who was born in Kerala, is locked in a keen contest with her former boss Karen Bass for the post of Mayor of Los Angeles, the second-largest city in the US.

READ: https://www.ptinews.com/story/international/us-votes-for-mid-term-elections-seen-as-referendum-on-trump/4225977

item.description:
PHOTO | A press statement issued by Ministry of Defence says, "In a swift and well-coordinated operation spanning over 48 hours, the Indian Navy successfully liberated the fishing vessel, Azini, from armed pirates. The operation culminated in the safe rescue of all 20 crew members, with no casualties or injuries.

Fishing Vessel Azini was reported to have been hijacked by an armed pirate group earlier last month, off the north-eastern coast of Somalia. The hijacking represented a significant maritime security threat, with the possibility of the vessel being employed as a ‘mother ship’ for launching further pirate attacks against merchant shipping in the region.

Responding to the situation, the Indian Navy tasked a mission-deployed warship to intervene, supported by a maritime reconnaissance aircraft. Working in close coordination, these platforms located the vessel after persistent surveillance, tracked its movements and employed calibrated non-kinetic measures to contain its movement and prevent its escape.

Marine Commandos were augmented through a precision airdrop by an Indian Air Force (IAF) C-17 aircraft.

Executing a swift and well-coordinated tactical intervention, the Indian Navy secured the vessel, overcame the pirate threat and ensured safe release of all 20 crew members.

The successful operation is testament to the Indian Navy’s high operational preparedness and ability to undertake complex maritime security operations through seamless inter-service coordination. It also underscores India’s unwavering commitment to remaining First Responder and Preferred Security Partner in the Indian Ocean Region.

The Indian Navy stands committed to safeguarding seafarers, protecting vital maritime trade routes and ensuring a safe, secure and stable maritime environment in the Indian Ocean Region."

(Photo source: Third Party)

item.description:
🇨🇳 🚨 CHINA: 401 MILLION CTRIP CUSTOMER RECORDS ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE

A threat actor on a dark web forum is selling a dataset of 401 million records they claim came from Ctrip (http://Trip.com Group), China's largest online travel platform. The asking price is $1,500 in crypto.

The actor claims the data includes:
* Full names, phone numbers and street addresses
* User IDs, account status and registration dates
* Hotel, rail and flight booking counts and booking history
* Upcoming departure dates and payment totals

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Fields such as last booking and next departure suggest fairly recent data, which would make travel-themed phishing and booking scams far more convincing. The 401M figure may include duplicates or older aggregated data. Ctrip has not confirmed an incident. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

#DDW #DarkWeb #China #Travel #DataBreach #ThreatIntelligence

item.description:
India Meteorological Department (@Indiametdept) posts on X, "The Severe Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu]” over Westcentral Bay of Bengal close to south Andhra Pradesh coast moved north-northwestwards with a speed of 08 kmph during past 06 hours, crossed south Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Narasapur close to Ongole (near Latitude 15.53°N and Longitude 80.22°E) during 0330 to 0530 hours IST with the wind speed of 100-110 kmph gusting to 120 kmph, and lay centered at 0530 hours IST of today the 03rd November, 2026 over south coastal Andhra Pradesh, near Latitude 15.6°N and Longitude 80.2°E close to Ongole, about 40 km southwest of Bapatla (Andhra Pradesh), 80 km north-northeast of Kavali (Andhra Pradesh), and 120 km west-southwest of Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh) and 130 km north of Nellore (Andhra Pradesh). It is likely to continue to move North-northwestwards and weaken gradually into a cyclonic storm (wind speed reaching 80-90 kmph gusting to 100 kmph) by noon and further into a deep depression (wind speed reaching 55-65 kmph gusting to 75 kmph) by midnight of today, the 3rd November,2026. It is under the continuous surveillance of Doppler Weather Radars at Machilipatnam and Visakhapatnam."

item.description:
🇮🇶 🚨 IRAQ: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS TO LEAK 2026 KIRKUK RESIDENCY DATABASE

A threat actor on an underground forum has posted what it calls a sample from the 2026 Kirkuk residency database.

The listing claims the records include:
* Full names, mothers' names, date and place of birth, gender
* Phone numbers and full addresses (district, sub-district, neighborhood, house number)
* National ID, civil status ID and residency card numbers
* Marital status, spouse details and number of children
* Minority-group membership, special needs and "martyr family" status

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If genuine, this is a highly sensitive civil-registry dataset. Kirkuk is an ethnically mixed, politically contested province, and fields flagging minority status and "martyr" families could expose residents to targeting, identity fraud and SIM-swap scams. No Iraqi authority has confirmed an incident, and the record count and the system it came from are unknown. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

🇵🇪 🚨 PERU: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS LEAK OF PROYECTO ESPECIAL CHAVIMOCHIC DATABASE

A threat actor on a dark web forum claims to have published a database belonging to Proyecto Especial CHAVIMOCHIC (PECH), the La Libertad regional government's irrigation and hydraulic infrastructure project that also supplies water to Trujillo, Peru.

According to the actor:
* More than 100,000 records were exfiltrated from the agency
* The data allegedly includes personal records and contact information
* Project details and administrative documents are also claimed

The forum post itself shows only the thread title ("DATABASE PROYECTO CHAVIMOCHIC GOB[.]PE") and a skull banner, with no sample rows or field list visible.

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
PECH runs dams, canals and water supply for one of Peru's largest agricultural regions, so staff, contractor, landholder and procurement records could be involved, enabling targeted phishing and fraud against people linked to the project. The poster is a new forum account and no sample has been shown, so the volume and contents remain unconfirmed. Peruvian public bodies are frequent targets of leak claims. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach of Proyecto Especial CHAVIMOCHIC.

item.description:
🇸🇪 🚨 SWEDEN: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS TO SELL 11M CABONLINE TAXI TRIP RECORDS

A threat actor on a dark web forum claims to be selling a database of about 11 million taxi trips allegedly linked to Cabonline (cabonline[.]com), the Nordic taxi group operating in Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark.

According to the post:
* 11,173,810 trip order lines, described as coming from "a large taxi ordering service integrated into booking"
* Data said to cover October 2024 to October 27, 2026
* Trip details reportedly include pickup and drop-off locations, dates and times, distances, fares, payment types, passenger counts and vehicle/driver identifiers
* Asking price listed as 1,500, with buyers told to send a private message

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Trip-level taxi data with timestamps and pickup/drop-off points can reveal home and work addresses, travel patterns and visits to sensitive locations, even without names attached, and driver/vehicle IDs could expose drivers. The post includes a sample of order IDs and timestamps but does not prove where the data came from; it could also come from a booking or dispatch partner. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach of Cabonline.
